title_pt: Areri, Bangale, Tana River — 16 carcaças de fauna silvestre
card_text_pt: O KWS informou apreensão de 16 carcaças envolvendo antílopes, girafas e galinhas-d’angola; uma motocicleta foi interceptada.
quantity_note_pt: O total regional acumulado de 93 carcaças não pertence exclusivamente a esta ocorrência. Sem distribuição confiável por grupo, manter 16 sem alocação; a data se apoia no relato de sexta-feira.
geographic_note_pt: Ponto de referência generalizado; não representa endereço exato.
context_pt:

[S1] A pesquisa examina caça para consumo como ameaça a mamíferos; impactos locais exigem dados próprios.

title_en: Areri, Bangale, Tana River — 16 wildlife carcasses
card_text_en: KWS reported 16 carcasses involving antelopes, giraffes and guineafowl; a motorcycle was intercepted.
quantity_note_en: The regional cumulative total of 93 carcasses is not this event’s count. Without a reliable group split, retain 16 unallocated; the date follows the Friday report.
geographic_note_en: Generalized reference point; not an exact address.
context_en:
[O1] The regional cumulative total of 93 carcasses is not this event’s count. Without a reliable group split, retain 16 unallocated; the date follows the Friday report.

[S1] Research examines hunting for consumption as a mammal threat; local impacts require separate evidence.

[N1] The news reference is the same as [O1], not a second independent confirmation.

[I1] UNODC emphasizes responses grounded in specific evidence. For this seizure, taxonomic identification and measurement units matter: pieces, carcasses and mass are not interchangeable measures of pressure on wild populations.
